EXT.evidence: Highly talkative and energetic during the birth, giving a running commentary, asking questions, and exclaiming (“Out!”, “Hello!”).

AGR.evidence: Polite and straightforward; apologizes (“Oh, sorry.”) and offers honest, non-boastful descriptions when asked.

CON.evidence: During the delivery is told “you’re not helping” and distracts by asking how it’s being done instead of assisting.

NEU.evidence: Shows excitement but no anxiety; speaks confidently (“definitely a boy,” greeting the baby) without signs of nervousness.

OPN.evidence: Curious and observant, asking how the delivery is done and noting detailed features; uses imaginative comparison (“looks like my uncle… covered in Jell-O”).
